project.name: Stickbot-TARS local voice smoke
project.thesis: A local-only TARS-like voice/audio stack for Stickbot: browser text+mic UI, local whisper.cpp STT, local XTTS voice generation, deterministic prosody/chunking, DSP/mastering, streaming-frame playback, and barge-in control without mutating OpenClaw production routing.

guardrails: Do not mutate OpenClaw Gateway config, production routing/default/fallbacks, NOA, Android, or provider settings for this project unless Stick explicitly authorizes it.
Do not use port 8787; it is reserved for NOA bridge work.
Do not use cloud STT by default and do not use browser Web Speech API.
Do not durably store raw mic transcripts; public/controller summaries use hashes/counts where possible.
Do not store runtime/model/audio/venv/cache artifacts under /mnt/c paths.
Do not commit generated audio, model files, venvs, caches, private keys, cert private keys, or runtime output directories.
Canonical assistant text is authoritative; prosody, DSP, mastering, mood, and audio polish must not rewrite response text.
TARS voice/branding remains private-demo-only until rights/branding review.

m7g.currentLimitation: Dashboard can read/upload/reset the local JSON matrix, switch moods dynamically, expose and persist concrete JSON XTTS/delivery values, map generic prosody sliders into concrete XTTS params, pass active XTTS params to the current single-utterance local XTTS request, and precompute per-chunk prosody sheet metadata. XTTS still receives canonical text as one request in the current path; true pitch shifting, timbre shaping, chunk-by-chunk synthesis, mid-speech parameter changes, pause insertion, and FFmpeg audio post-processing remain M7H/M7I work.

m7h.currentLimitation: Current XTTS runtime remains one request per assistant turn; M7H now computes an utterance-level effective XTTS envelope from per-chunk scores. Full chunk-by-chunk synthesis, rest insertion, stitching, and per-chunk audio artifacts remain M7I. FFmpeg/DSP post-processing remains an optional later M7H polish lane.

serverIntegration.publicApi: voicePlan.audioPerformance exposes redacted audio pipeline summary
serverIntegration.rawTextBoundary: raw chunk text remains internal to local synthesis; public summaries expose textSha256 only

m7i.currentLimitation: M7I is local sequential chunk synthesis/rendering, not realtime full duplex. DSP is reserved as a native stage but not implemented yet. Streaming can reuse the chunk frame contract in a later milestone.

integration.dsp: xtts-chunk-conductor accepts dspProcessor; server passes polishChunkArtifacts before WAV stitch/render
integration.streaming: xtts-chunk-conductor emits realtime frame manifest and pipeline stages.realtime
integration.duplex: full-duplex controller provides deterministic listen/think/speak/barge-in/resume transitions

m7jkl.currentLimitation: M7J/K/L provide local DSP processing, streaming frame contracts, and deterministic duplex state transitions. M7M/N/O add browser/client smoke wiring and redacted ingress; true live partial STT and low-latency transport remain later work.

integration.m7m: browser consumes voicePlan.audioPerformance.realtime.frames and plays generated chunk audio URLs in order with computed pauses; final WAV remains fallback
integration.m7n: POST /api/stt/partial and /api/stt final responses produce redacted duplex-controller summaries without raw transcript durable storage
integration.m7o: starting mic capture stops active streaming playback and posts a deterministic barge-in/resume scenario to /api/duplex/scenario

newGates: generated UUID chunk .wav files are accepted for streaming playback smoke

m7mno.currentLimitation: M7M/N/O local implementation and automated smoke gates passed. M7P live browser proof now confirmed streaming frame playback, audible TARS, and mic-start barge-in stop. True partial local STT loop and low-latency transport remain later work.

m7p.uiFix: Changed raw transcript durable storage wording from error-like status to privacy guard wording in public/app.js

r2FinalWavBargeInFix.finding: Manual playback of the final WAV fallback was not stopped by mic-start because only the streaming chunk Audio object was tracked as active playback.
r2FinalWavBargeInFix.fix: Registered inline final WAV audio elements by turnId and made stopActivePlayback pause/reset any registered or currently-playing audio element while preserving final WAV replay/save ability.

r3StreamingMicLifecycleConfirmation.finding: After live streaming playback cut out on mic-start, the mic continued recording with no break and no browser error.

m7p.currentLimitation: M7P verified live browser playback and mic-start interruption. It did not verify non-blank spoken interruption recognition or true low-latency streaming while synthesis is still running.

integration.placement: after M7J DSP and before M7K realtime frame manifest plus final stitch
integration.streamingPlayback: audio_chunk_ready frames include mastering.outputFileBasename and browser prefers mastered chunk files
integration.finalPlayback: final stitched WAV is rendered from mastered chunks
integration.rawPreservation: raw XTTS chunk artifacts and DSP intermediates remain on disk under local output dir

r2TruncationFix.finding: Initial M5.6 sounded better but produced about 0:02 and cut off mid-sentence.
r2TruncationFix.rootCause: FFmpeg silenceremove stop_periods=1 can treat normal phrase pauses as end-of-audio.
r2TruncationFix.fix: Removed end/tail trimming and kept only conservative leading-silence trim.
r2TruncationFix.regressionGate: M5.6 filter must not contain stop_periods=

r3TailGuardFix.finding: R2 timing was much better but final syllable clipped slightly at the end of the full sentence.
r3TailGuardFix.fix: Added 320 ms apad tail guard after mastering while keeping end/tail trimming disabled.
r3TailGuardFix.regressionGate: M5.6 filter includes apad=pad_dur=0.320 and does not contain stop_periods=

r4TerminalTailDrainFix.finding: R3 preserved voice body but still cut the final syllable in half abruptly.
r4TerminalTailDrainFix.fix: Increased post-mastering apad tail guard to 900 ms and added a TTS-only terminal render hint for the final chunk while preserving canonical text/hash.
r4TerminalTailDrainFix.regressionGate: M5.6 filter includes apad=pad_dur=0.900, final chunk applies terminalTailHintApplied=true, and canonical text remains unchanged.

m56.currentLimitation: M5.6 R4 passed live browser tail/drain confirmation. Remaining voice work before production closeout includes live-driven prosody/mood scoring and audio-first multiplexed streaming architecture.
